theorems.name: Submission.dor_zdm_point_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ξ₀ : MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → (∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, D ω = ξ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) ∧ ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, D ω = ξ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) → ξ₀ ≠ 0 → D.support = {x}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
